mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and a high of 96 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park. Please be aware that the air quality is currently at a moderate level of 53.

The city is busy with several updates. You can sign up for the free trishaw bike program to enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail, or join the development discussion at the August 3rd Plan Commission meeting regarding local projects like the Ardent Glen subdivision.

There is plenty to do in town. We have yoga today at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at Paddy Mac's on Wednesday.
In our weekly police update, an officer conducted a traffic stop on July 26 for a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour. The driver was found to be impaired and was arrested for an O-W-I.
Cap off your day with the Culver's flavor of the day, OREO Cookie Overload. They are open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
